title: Claude for students

body.text: a personal tutor with endless patience
— ask as many times as you want, adjust the level of explanation, and get fresh examples until it clicks.

example: "Explain photosynthesis simply, then give an everyday example — I'm just starting grade 10"

title: Tutor mode — two-way learning

body.text: Instead of just reading the answer, tell Claude to
teach with the Socratic method — ask questions back
— this helps you understand more deeply and remember longer than reading alone.

example: "Help me learn calculus by asking me questions to think first; don't give the answer directly until I've tried"

question: Why is Claude well-suited as a tutor?

options.text: Claude has past exams for every subject
Claude is patient, can re-explain unlimited times, and adapts to the learner
Claude is connected to real teachers

question: What is the Socratic method of teaching?

options.text: Asking questions back so the learner works out the answer themselves
Having them read a book first

question: What makes Claude teach at the right level for the learner?

options.text: Tell it your level and background knowledge in the prompt

question: How should a student use Claude effectively?

options.text: Have it do all the homework for you
Have it explain and ask review questions, not copy the answers

question: What does two-way tutor mode mean?

options.text: Back-and-forth Q&A until the learner truly understands
